# Statistical analysis of the fitted models (paper Sec. 3.4, 3.4.1, 3.5; Table 2).
# Knit from this folder (stats/); inputs are read from ../results/.
#   Rscript -e 'rmarkdown::render("fitting_analysis.Rmd")'
# R packages: data.table, ggplot2, Rmisc, ARTool, effectsize (+ rmarkdown, knitr to render)
packages <- c("ggplot2", "data.table", "Rmisc", "effectsize", "ARTool")
results_dir <- file.path("..", "results")

# sapply(packages, install.packages)
sapply(packages, require, character.only = TRUE)

# https://stackoverflow.com/questions/40901445/function-to-calculate-r2-r-squared-in-r#40901487
rsq <- function (x, y, m='spearman') cor(x, y,method = m) ^ 2

theme_set(theme_classic(base_size = 10))
theme_update(text = element_text(size = 10),
             legend.text=element_text(size=7),
             scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2"),
             scale_colour_brewer(palette = "Set2"))

```{r}
dt <- as.data.table(read.csv(file.path(results_dir, "fitting_results.csv")))
# dt2 <- as.data.table(read.csv("fits_results_AXD_no_rectifier.csv"))
dt$model <- 'original'

# Number of observations per participant: n_trials (from fit_listener) equals the number of
# 'Measured' trials per participant in the behavioural data (AXD_full_dataset_20260202.csv)
dt[, N := n_trials]
dt <- dt[order(participant)]

# dt <- dt[!participant %in% c('P0204', 'P0224', 'P0228', 'P0239', 'P0244', 'P0259', 'P0330', 'P0350')]
# dt <- dt[!participant %in% c('P0204', 'P0228', 'P0239', 'P0243', 'P0244', 'P0259', 'P0330')]
# dt <- dt[!participant %in% c( 'P0239', 'P0243', 'P0261', 'P0020',
#                               'P0204', 'P0228', 'P0244', 'P0330')]

# dt <- dt[participant %in% n_obs_per_participant[N > 100]$participant]

# Define number of parameters per method
# You'll need to adjust these based on your actual models
# Typically: sigma_spectral, sigma_motor, sigma_prior 
k_params <- 3

# Compute BIC
# BIC = k*log(n) + 2*NLL
dt[, BIC := k_params * log(N) + 2 * nll_500]

# For model comparison, compute delta BIC relative to baseline within each participant
dt[, delta_BIC := BIC - min(BIC), by = participant]

aa <- dcast(dt, participant ~ method, value.var = "delta_BIC")
# Count how many times each method is best
dt[, .(best_method = method[which.min(delta_BIC)]), by = participant][, .N, by = best_method]

# Plot delta BIC instead of llz
summarySE(dt, measurevar = "delta_BIC", groupvars = c("method", 'model')) |> 
  ggplot() + 
  geom_pointrange(aes(x = method, y = delta_BIC, ymin = delta_BIC-se, ymax = delta_BIC+se, color = model), 
                  position = position_dodge(width = .2)) +
  labs(y = "delta_BIC (lower is better)", 
       title = "Model comparison via BIC")

write.csv(dt, 'fitting_results_bic.csv')

summarySE(dt, measurevar = "delta_BIC", groupvars = c("method", 'model'))
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# 1. Friedman test
# ============================================================
bic_wide <- dcast(dt, participant ~ method, value.var = "BIC")
friedman <- friedman.test(as.matrix(bic_wide[, .(SHMAX, SH, barycentric, barumerli2023)]))
cat("=== FRIEDMAN TEST ===\n")
print(friedman)
```


```{r}
# ============================================================
# 2. Pairwise Wilcoxon signed-rank tests (BIC differences)
# ============================================================
methods <- c("SHMAX", "SH", "barycentric", "barumerli2023")
pairs <- combn(methods, 2, simplify = FALSE)

pairwise_results <- rbindlist(lapply(pairs, function(pair) {
  a <- pair[1]; b <- pair[2]
  bic_a <- dt[method == a, .(participant, BIC_a = BIC)]
  bic_b <- dt[method == b, .(participant, BIC_b = BIC)]
  merged <- merge(bic_a, bic_b, by = "participant")
  d <- merged$BIC_b - merged$BIC_a  # positive = a wins
  
  wt <- wilcox.test(d, alternative = "two.sided", exact = FALSE)
  
  data.table(
    method_a = a,
    method_b = b,
    wins_a = sum(d > 0),
    wins_b = sum(d < 0),
    n = length(d),
    median_delta = median(d),
    W = as.numeric(wt$statistic),
    p = wt$p.value
  )
}))

# Holm correction
pairwise_results[, p_holm := p.adjust(p, method = "bonferroni")]

cat("\n=== PAIRWISE WILCOXON SIGNED-RANK TESTS ===\n")
print(pairwise_results[order(p)], digits = 4)
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# 4. Kass & Raftery categories: SHMAX vs barumerli2023
# ============================================================
shmax_bic <- dt[method == "SHMAX", .(participant, BIC_shmax = BIC)]
baru_bic  <- dt[method == "barumerli2023", .(participant, BIC_baru = BIC)]
kr <- merge(shmax_bic, baru_bic, by = "participant")
kr[, delta := BIC_baru - BIC_shmax]  # positive = SHMAX wins

cat("\n=== KASS & RAFTERY: SHMAX vs barumerli2023 ===\n")
cat(sprintf("Strong for SHMAX (dBIC > 10):    %d\n", kr[delta > 10, .N]))
cat(sprintf("Positive for SHMAX (2 < dBIC <= 10): %d\n", kr[delta > 2 & delta <= 10, .N]))
cat(sprintf("Negligible (|dBIC| <= 2):          %d\n", kr[abs(delta) <= 2, .N]))
cat(sprintf("Positive for baru (-10 <= dBIC < -2): %d\n", kr[delta < -2 & delta >= -10, .N]))
cat(sprintf("Strong for baru (dBIC < -10):     %d\n", kr[delta < -10, .N]))
```


```{r}
# ============================================================
# 5. Kass & Raftery categories: barycentric vs barumerli2023
# ============================================================
bary_bic <- dt[method == "barycentric", .(participant, BIC_bary = BIC)]
kr2 <- merge(bary_bic, baru_bic, by = "participant")
kr2[, delta := BIC_baru - BIC_bary]

cat("\n=== KASS & RAFTERY: barycentric vs barumerli2023 ===\n")
cat(sprintf("Strong for barycentric (dBIC > 10):    %d\n", kr2[delta > 10, .N]))
cat(sprintf("Positive for barycentric (2 < dBIC <= 10): %d\n", kr2[delta > 2 & delta <= 10, .N]))
cat(sprintf("Negligible (|dBIC| <= 2):                %d\n", kr2[abs(delta) <= 2, .N]))
cat(sprintf("Positive for baru (-10 <= dBIC < -2):    %d\n", kr2[delta < -2 & delta >= -10, .N]))
cat(sprintf("Strong for baru (dBIC < -10):           %d\n", kr2[delta < -10, .N]))
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# 3. Friedman test on sigma_prior across methods
# ============================================================
prior_wide <- dcast(dt, participant ~ method, value.var = "sigma_prior")
friedman_prior <- friedman.test(as.matrix(prior_wide[, .(SHMAX, SH, barycentric, barumerli2023)]))
cat("\n=== FRIEDMAN: sigma_prior ===\n")
print(friedman_prior)

# Per-method summary
cat("\n--- sigma_prior summary by method ---\n")
dt[, .(median = median(sigma_prior),
       q25 = quantile(sigma_prior, 0.25),
       q75 = quantile(sigma_prior, 0.75),
       mean = mean(sigma_prior),
       sd = sd(sigma_prior)), by = method][order(median)] |> print(digits = 3)

# Pairwise Wilcoxon on sigma_prior (follow-up to significant Friedman)
cat("\n--- sigma_prior pairwise Wilcoxon ---\n")
methods <- c("SHMAX", "SH", "barycentric", "barumerli2023")
pairs <- combn(methods, 2, simplify = FALSE)
prior_pairwise <- rbindlist(lapply(pairs, function(pair) {
  a <- prior_wide[[pair[1]]]
  b <- prior_wide[[pair[2]]]
  wt <- wilcox.test(a, b, paired = TRUE, exact = FALSE)
  data.table(method_a = pair[1], method_b = pair[2],
             median_a = median(a), median_b = median(b),
             V = as.numeric(wt$statistic), p = wt$p.value)
}))
prior_pairwise[, p_holm := p.adjust(p, method = "holm")]
print(prior_pairwise[order(p)], digits = 4)
```

}

}

### posterior

```{r}
df <- as.data.table(read.csv(file.path(results_dir, "synthetic_vs_actual_comparison.csv")))

actual <- df[data_type == "actual"]
setkey(actual, participant)

methods <- c("SHMAX", "barycentric", "SH", "barumerli2023")
metrics <- c("rmsL_deg", "rmsPmedianlocal_deg", "querrMiddlebrooks")
metric_labels <- c("rmsL", "PE (local)", "QE (%)")

# ============================================================
# 1. Correlations and bias for main metrics
# ============================================================
cat("=== POSTERIOR PREDICTIVE CHECKS ===\n\n")

results <- rbindlist(lapply(methods, function(m) {
  model <- df[method == m]
  setkey(model, participant)
  common <- intersect(actual$participant, model$participant)
  
  rbindlist(lapply(seq_along(metrics), function(i) {
    a <- actual[common, get(metrics[i])]
    mod <- model[common, get(metrics[i])]
    
    ct <- cor.test(a, mod, method = "pearson")
    wt <- wilcox.test(mod - a, exact = FALSE)
    
    data.table(
      method = m,
      metric = metric_labels[i],
      mean_actual = mean(a),
      mean_model = mean(mod),
      bias = mean(mod) - mean(a),
      r = ct$estimate,
      r_p = ct$p.value,
      W = as.numeric(wt$statistic),
      wilcox_p = wt$p.value
    )
  }))
}))

cat("--- Pearson r ---\n")
r_wide <- dcast(results, metric ~ method, value.var = "r")
print(r_wide, digits = 3)

cat("\n--- Pearson r p-values ---\n")
rp_wide <- dcast(results, metric ~ method, value.var = "r_p")
print(rp_wide, digits = 4)

cat("\n--- Mean bias (model - actual) ---\n")
bias_wide <- dcast(results, metric ~ method, value.var = "bias")
print(bias_wide, digits = 2)

cat("\n--- Wilcoxon signed-rank p (model vs actual) ---\n")
wp_wide <- dcast(results, metric ~ method, value.var = "wilcox_p")
print(wp_wide, digits = 4)
```


```{r}
# ============================================================
# 2. Actual data summary
# ============================================================
cat("\n=== ACTUAL DATA SUMMARY ===\n")
n <- actual[, .N]
for (i in seq_along(metrics)) {
  vals <- actual[, get(metrics[i])]
  cat(sprintf("%s: %.1f ± %.1f (SE), SD = %.1f, N = %d\n",
              metric_labels[i], mean(vals), sd(vals) / sqrt(n), sd(vals), n))
}
```


```{r}
# ============================================================
# 3. Accuracy metrics (accL, accP) — light treatment
# ============================================================
cat("\n=== ACCURACY METRICS (accL, accP at ±30°) ===\n\n")

acc_metrics <- c("accL_cutoff_30_deg", "accP_cutoff_30_deg")
acc_labels <- c("accL (±30°)", "accP (±30°)")

acc_results <- rbindlist(lapply(methods, function(m) {
  model <- df[method == m]
  setkey(model, participant)
  common <- intersect(actual$participant, model$participant)
  
  rbindlist(lapply(seq_along(acc_metrics), function(i) {
    a <- actual[common, get(acc_metrics[i])]
    mod <- model[common, get(acc_metrics[i])]
    
    ct <- cor.test(a, mod, method = "pearson")
    wt <- wilcox.test(mod - a, exact = FALSE)
    
    data.table(
      method = m,
      metric = acc_labels[i],
      mean_actual = mean(a),
      mean_model = mean(mod),
      bias = mean(mod) - mean(a),
      r = ct$estimate,
      r_p = ct$p.value,
      W = as.numeric(wt$statistic),
      wilcox_p = wt$p.value
    )
  }))
}))

print(acc_results[, .(method, metric, mean_actual = round(mean_actual, 2),
                       mean_model = round(mean_model, 2),
                       bias = round(bias, 2),
                       r = round(r, 3), r_p = round(r_p, 4),
                       wilcox_p = round(wilcox_p, 4))])
```
